svg.title: Different chips. Different engines. Three execution-path transformations.
svg.desc: NVIDIA: eliminate the global-memory round trip for an intermediate by fusing a gated epilogue in registers. Qualcomm IQ9: two NPUs already share matrix work; redistribute KV heads and attention between them. Apple: select the token on the GPU and return only its ID while decode state stays resident. These are separate illustrative implementation examples, not measured timing traces.
